quote: We booked in Utkarsha on a Sunday and got possession on the date written in the agreement. My father had dealt with Marc in 1996 — that is why we came back.
name: Sunil Deshmukh

quote: Every month we received a photo of the slab work. Nobody had to chase anyone. The flat we saw in the drawing is the flat we live in.
name: Archana Jadhav

quote: The price sheet they gave us on day one is the amount we finally paid. For a family buying its first home, that mattered more than anything.
name: Imran Shaikh
